label: Database Operations Pro
summary: Advanced database topology workflows covering replication planning, replica initialization, lag review, controlled promotion and qualified extension campaigns. Engine-specific capabilities and external-service limits remain explicit.
core_boundary: Database creation, users/grants, credential rotation, import/export, baseline diagnostics and ordinary backups stay in the free Core. Database Operations adds optional advanced orchestration and never receives the control-plane PostgreSQL credentials.
acceptance: Qualify replication and promotion procedures per engine/version/provider; unsupported failover actions must remain unavailable.
Verify current topology, fencing, replica lag and recovery-point requirements before a promotion; refuse split-brain conditions.
Use narrowly scoped hosted-database identities and separately authorize extension changes through the Data owner.
Exercise interrupted initialization, credential revocation, stale topology and failed promotion without silently selecting a new primary.
Disabling the module must preserve databases, grants, replication safety and documented engine-specific recovery.
